title: wg: protocol-06 presentation-language syntax errors
description: Erratum. Undefined types IdentifierURI (L1538), RoomId (L2266), string (L1489, L2543). "optional Frank" not optional<Frank> (L1596, L1937; same at L2085). case success where SubmitResponseCode defines accepted(0) (L1592 vs L1574). success(0); semicolons in an enum (L1237). select(type) where field is searchType (L2428). Missing ; (L3058) and brace (L1419). "opaque signature_public_key;" with no <V> (L2875, L2897). mimid reads intent (decisions mimid-1wgh.5.19, .5.20, .5.21, .5.25, .5.31, .5.14). Fix: correct the syntax.
